headline: Acceptance of additional applications for mortgage loan subsidies begins on November 25
summary: Additional applications for mortgage loan subsidies open on November 25 at 10:00. The applications draw on previously issued notices that were not used in time, and can be submitted via DXM, myGov, or my.gov.uz.
why: State mortgage subsidies affect household demand for housing and lending volumes at Uzbek banks. The measure is local and modest in scale.
original_headline: Ipoteka kreditlari bo‘yicha subsidiyalarga qo‘shimcha ariza qabul qilish 25-noyabrdan boshlanadi
